details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant upswing, adding over $200 billion in total market capitalization within 24 hours. Bitcoin (BTC) surged past $70,000 to reach a two-month high, while Ethereum (ETH) also saw substantial gains, breaking past $2,300. This rally was largely fueled by a cascade of short liquidations and renewed optimism following the U.S. Treasury's expanded bond buyback program, which injected liquidity into the broader financial markets.
title: Bitcoin Leads Broad Crypto Market Rally, Total Cap Surges $200 Billion

details: Despite Bitcoin's impressive surge above the $70,000 mark, some analysts and traders are expressing caution, suggesting that the rapid rally could be a "bull trap." Warnings indicate a potential correction to the $44,000-$48,000 range before a more sustainable upward trend can establish.
title: Bitcoin Hits $70K, But Traders Warn of Potential $44K Bull Trap

details: Standard Chartered's Head of Digital Assets Research, Geoff Kendrick, has reiterated the bank's prediction for Bitcoin to reach $100,000 by the end of 2026. This forecast comes as the U.S. Treasury's decision to double its long-dated bond buybacks is seen as a significant catalyst, providing substantial liquidity that could further propel Bitcoin's price.
title: Standard Chartered Reiterates $100K Bitcoin Target Amid Treasury Buyback Shock

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) is actively developing its own digital asset market structure proposals. CFTC Chair Michael Selig stated that the agency is prepared to move forward with these regulations, even if the comprehensive CLARITY Act, aimed at establishing a clear regulatory framework for crypto, does not pass Congress.
title: CFTC Preparing Crypto Rules Independently, Regardless of CLARITY Act

details: Former President Donald Trump met with key crypto industry executives at the White House, urging Congress to pass a "fair version" of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. Trump emphasized that such legislation is crucial for the United States to maintain its leadership position in the global cryptocurrency and blockchain technology space.
title: Trump Pushes for Crypto CLARITY Act to Cement US Leadership
